decisionBox.changed: Midday said range with a bearish tilt and an ADD of small spot DCA. The 81,212 reduce line then confirmed on 1H closes (17:00 and 18:00 COT) and price broke the 80,925 and 80,680 supports intraday (low 80,514.5), so the bias moves from range to bearish. Realized liquidations flipped to long-heavy ($706k long vs $66k short). Overnight stance is defensive: trim spot, keep cash, rest a stop under the wick low.

overnightRisk: Next report is ~02:00 COT, a 6.5-hour gap that includes the Asia open. Longs are still crowded (1H long/short account ratio 2.11) with $706k of longs already flushed at 80.5-80.7k, so a clean break of 80,514.5 can cascade toward 79,775 and the estimated 78.3k pocket in thin weekend liquidity. Weekend: US cash markets are closed (QQQ 704.40, VOO 698.58 closes), Oct 23 spot ETF flows not published yet (Oct 22 was -635.6M), Brent 116.91 (+3.3%) and US10Y 5.00% keep macro risk-off. A resting stop at 80,350 is the only protection while nobody is watching; a squeeze above 81,850 would be the only upside surprise.
